name: Charming Diplomat
body:
You are quite skilled in reconciling quarreling factions.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Skill Focus (Diplomacy)

Benefit(s): When attempting to use Diplomacy to improve the attitude of an individual, you gain an extra +3 bonus to the attempt and can shift any creature’s attitude by up to 3 steps with a successful skill check.
